referenceEdits.why: `dsh_make_home_overlay` fails only when a link or the settings file of the throwaway DSH_HOME cannot be written (`proposer.sh:407` to `:433`), and no permission can express that on a hermetic host that runs as root. The edit makes the settings file of the throwaway home a DIRECTORY before the build, so the redirection `> "$overlay/settings.yaml"` fails with EISDIR for any user, which is the reproducible form of 'the settings file cannot be written'. The line under test (`proposer.sh:557`, the handler that reports 'could not build DSH_HOME overlay' and returns 1) is untouched, and so is `dsh_make_home_overlay` itself. This answers CQ-pending-141-1 for this scenario the way `FX-26/fallback-tap-unavailable` answers it for the tap: through a declared as-is edit of a private writable copy, never of the pinned tree (F141-FR-002).
